recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future work on definition-based Questionnaire behavior should be evaluated under the later issue that requests it, not as additional FHIR-5740 work.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Questionnaire issue requesting guidance that even when a question references a standard code or DataElement definition, inline question text, data type, and value set SHOULD still be declared, and inline question details should align with the referenced definition while local environments decide the exact alignment rules.
initial_application: The issue was pre-applied as SVN build #4158, represented in git by 8a2625aee31183a1806fa80707ff95ed78aa88f8, which added the requested note to source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini. Later source history moved the DSTU1-era code/deReference/DataElement framing to the current Questionnaire.item.definition, ElementDefinition, StructureDefinition, logical-model, and questionnaire-definitionBased model, including FHIR-28305, without removing the FHIR-5740 interoperability guidance. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current Question Definitions section already states that even if a standard question definition is provided, question text, data type, and value set SHOULD still be declared; it warns that processors might not resolve external definitions; it links definition-dependent questionnaires to questionnaire-definitionBased; and it preserves the expected-but-locally-governed alignment rule.

related_jiras.note: Added definitionBased guidance and clarified derived Questionnaire.item values in the same Question Definitions section, supporting the current-source interpretation.
